name: Ezhance – Product Discounts and Bulk Pricing for WooCommerce
author: Sathyaseelan

sections.description:
Running promotions in WooCommerce should not feel complicated.

Most store owners do not just need “a discount plugin.” They need a way to solve real sales problems:

Customers leave without adding enough products to the cart.
Shoppers miss your offers because discounts are not clearly shown.
Basic coupons do not help you promote specific products.
Bulk pricing is hard to explain on product pages.
You want to sell more units without manually changing prices.
You need seasonal campaigns, flash offers, and product-specific promotions.
You want customers to come back after they place an order.
You want better offers, but you do not want a confusing rule builder.

Ezhance helps WooCommerce merchants create clear, practical promotions that encourage customers to buy more.

With Ezhance, you can create product discounts, bulk discounts, tiered pricing, BOGO-style campaigns, cart promotions, product-page offer displays, order coupons, and more from a focused WooCommerce promotion engine.

Better Offers. Bigger Orders.

Built for Real WooCommerce Promotion Problems

Problem: Customers buy only one item

Use bulk discounts or tiered pricing to encourage larger quantities.

Example:

Buy 2 or more and save 5%
Buy 5 or more and save 10%
Buy 10 or more and save 15%

This helps increase average order value without manually adjusting product prices.

Problem: Shoppers do not notice your discounts

A discount that customers cannot see will not convert well.

Ezhance can show offer messages, product-page offer cards, bulk pricing tables, and strikeout prices so customers understand the deal before they add products to the cart.

Problem: You want to promote selected products

Not every discount should apply storewide.

Ezhance lets you create offers for selected products, so you can promote new arrivals, seasonal items, slow-moving stock, best sellers, or specific campaign products.

Problem: Regular coupons are not enough

WooCommerce coupons are useful, but many campaigns need more structure.

Ezhance helps you build promotion rules around products, cart conditions, quantities, schedules, usage limits, and display settings.

Problem: You want bigger orders, not just cheaper orders

Good promotions should guide customers toward a better purchase.

Use Ezhance to create offers that encourage shoppers to add more items, increase quantity, reach a cart goal, or return for another order.

What You Can Do with Ezhance Free

Ezhance Free gives merchants a practical starting point for WooCommerce promotions.

You can create:

Simple product discounts
Percentage discounts
Fixed amount discounts
Bulk quantity discounts
Tiered pricing offers
Product-specific offers
Product include and exclude rules
Cart subtotal conditions
Cart line item count conditions
Scheduled offers with start and end dates
Usage-limited promotions
Product-page offer cards
Bulk pricing tables
Strikeout price displays
Basic promotion templates
Basic promotion analytics

Ezhance Free is best for stores that want to start creating better product discounts, quantity offers, and visible storefront promotions.

When to Upgrade to Ezhance Pro

Ezhance Pro is built for stores that want more advanced campaigns and stronger conversion tools.

Upgrade to Pro when you want to create:

Buy X Get X offers
Buy X Get Y offers
BOGO promotions
Cart discounts
Order coupons
Free gift campaigns
Shipping goal campaigns
Advanced targeting rules
Customer role offers
First-time customer offers
Returning customer offers
Purchase history based offers
Location-based offers
Advanced schedules
Cart progress bars
Campaign banners
Countdown timers
Advanced analytics
Import and export tools
Premium promotion templates

View Ezhance Pro pricing:
https://ezhance.app/pricing/

Why Ezhance Works for Merchants

Ezhance is designed to keep promotions understandable.

Instead of forcing you to manage scattered coupons and confusing settings, Ezhance gives you a focused promotion workflow:

Choose the offer type.
Select the products or rules.
Set the discount.
Control timing and limits.
Display the offer clearly.
Track how the promotion performs.

This makes it easier to launch offers, test campaigns, and improve your WooCommerce store without turning every promotion into a technical task.

sections.installation:
Install Ezhance from the WordPress plugin directory.
Activate the plugin.
Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
Go to the Ezhance menu in your WordPress dashboard.
Create your first promotion.
Select your products, discount type, rules, display settings, and schedule.
Activate the promotion and test it on your storefront.

Getting started guide:
https://ezhance.app/docs/create-your-first-promotion/
sections.faq:
What does Ezhance do?

Ezhance helps WooCommerce merchants create discounts, bulk pricing, tiered offers, product-page promotions, BOGO campaigns, cart offers, order coupons, and other sales campaigns.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Ezhance is built for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Can I use Ezhance for simple product discounts?

Yes. You can create simple percentage or fixed amount discounts for selected products.

Can I create bulk discounts?

Yes. Ezhance supports bulk and tiered quantity discounts, which are useful when you want customers to buy more units.

Can I show discount offers on product pages?

Yes. Ezhance can show product-page offer cards, bulk pricing tables, applied offer messages, and strikeout prices.

Can I create BOGO offers?

Buy X Get X and Buy X Get Y offers are available in Ezhance Pro.

Can I create order coupons?

Order coupons are available in Ezhance Pro.

Can I target specific products?

Yes. Ezhance Free supports selected product targeting with include and exclude options. Advanced targeting is available in Pro.

Can I schedule promotions?

Yes. Ezhance supports start and end dates for promotions.

Can I limit how many times an offer is used?

Yes. Ezhance supports usage limits for promotions.

Does Ezhance include analytics?

Yes. Ezhance Free includes basic promotion analytics. Ezhance Pro includes advanced analytics for deeper campaign insights.

Where can I see examples?

Visit the demo store:
https://demo.ezhance.app/

Where can I get help?

Read the documentation:
https://ezhance.app/docs/

Contact support:
https://ezhance.app/support/
